text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, droperidol 2.5 mg/mL 2 mL vials are not on FDA's drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 62 vials (9.1 days at 6.8 vials per day). Corvale General holds 113 vials (13.2 days at 8.5 vials per day).

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include droperidol as of 2026-10-21. The current label identifies Hikma Farmaceutica (Portugal), S.A. (FEI 3002807173) as the manufacturing plant. That plant received a Warning Letter on 2014-10-21 and an OAI inspection classification on 2014-03-28. Its most recent inspections in 2023 were classified VAI. American Regent, Inc.'s plant was last inspected VAI on 2024-04-24.

Our position: Current inventory provides limited days on hand at both sites. No national shortage is declared by FDA. Supply continuity depends on proactive purchasing from a manufacturer with recent acceptable inspection history.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer places purchase orders with American Regent, Inc. for droperidol 2.5 mg/mL 2 mL vials to replenish both sites; Pharmacy Director approves.
2. Buyer confirms delivery schedules and allocates received stock to Corvale East and Corvale General; Pharmacy Director approves.
3. Buyer monitors FDA's drug shortage list weekly for any status change and reports updates to the committee; Pharmacy Director approves.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement until inventory falls below seven days on hand. Switching to alternative agents without committee review.
